outcome: The journey stage derives from ONE published, versioned threshold set over visit-local counters, using the one shared stage vocabulary JOURNEY_STAGES = ['exploring','thinking','deciding'] in that order. R32(1): the threshold set is the `journey` block of the already-published, tenant-scoped REFLEX_KIND document both hosts and the content decision read, and every revision carries its own stamped version identity. The thresholds are data, not constants: the same counters under two published sets give two stages. The reflex validator refuses, returning EVERY error and naming the journey block, a stage word outside the vocabulary, stages out of vocabulary order, a threshold on the first stage, a fractional or negative threshold, a counter the visit does not keep, a stage with no threshold and an empty set.
